callback_ds_weight_decay

Source: R/utilities.R
callback_ds_weight_decay.Rd

Decay ancillary deep supervision loss weights during luz training.

Usage

callback_ds_weight_decay(weight_env, decay = "linear", primary_only_frac = 0.1)

Arguments

weight_env

A weight environment created by make_ds_weights and shared with ds_loss.

decay

Character string, either "linear" (default) or "cosine".

primary_only_frac

Numeric value in (0, 1) specifying the fraction of total epochs at the end of training during which only the primary loss is used (ancillary weights are zero). Defaults to 0.1.

Value

A luz callback object.

Details

A luz callback that reduces the weights of ancillary outputs (all elements of weight_env$values except the first) toward zero over the decaying portion of training, leaving the primary output weight unchanged. The fraction of epochs reserved for primary-loss-only training is controlled by primary_only_frac (default 0.1, i.e. the final 10\ epochs).

Two decay schedules are supported:

"linear"

Ancillary weights decrease linearly from their initial values to zero. Matches the nnU-Net strategy.

"cosine"

Ancillary weights follow a cosine curve, decaying slowly at first and more rapidly through mid-training.
